findings.before: Ordinary native gx_query_catalog(reference=...) returned a method without source_ref. Explicit kind=method returned a citeable document, while citation validation filtered out other request kinds.
findings.fix: Issue and accept method citations by exact returned kind/reference and existing document hash, current bound reader and module delivery receipt.
findings.frozen_cases: Scoped modules still cannot use the delivery to another researcher. Historical typed method queries still pass.

findings.before: Register an incorrect digest for fixture-grid@1 in a private deployment. Both normal quick and deep gx-p0 research returned 1: VersionImmutable: The public method metadata differs from the registered release, before any search.
findings.fix: Verify each released method independently in the current discovery index and frozen public read list. Return the exclusions to the Lead and keep the broken method unselectable. Existing pinned Goal and old strict discovery behavior preserved.

findings.before: 17 previously read scientific artifacts disappeared across two consecutive Lead contexts in the first A2 field Run, even though all 17 remained in scope.
findings.fix: Carry verified and released source refs plus newly delivered author findings across surveys and cold reopening. Keep unreported private module drafts out.

findings.before: Catalog ranking tokenized all opaque artifact/source IDs and dictionary keys and did not use the newly reported researcher finding.
findings.fix: Use research question, PI update, output requirements, material roles/names and fresh researcher findings, gaps and next steps.

validation.control: local controlled native responses, no paid model. Separate normal-goal demonstrations below used no Jobs.

note: The separate archival calibration package also reported an installed-byte mismatch during this probe. Its owner was notified separately; these read-only diagnostics intentionally retain the observed response.
